channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Billionaire's $40 million Ferrari purchase may yield $13 million tax savings
item.description: Dr. Herbert A. Wertheim, an 87-year-old optometrist and philanthropist, bought the first Ferrari Luce for $40 million, potentially saving $13 million in taxes.

item.title: NYC sends 11,000 more pied-à-terre tax letters, apologizes to 1,200 wrongly targeted
item.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani admitted the city lacked 2025 tax data before sending 17,000 warning letters.

item.title: Fired Stars and Stripes staff sue Pentagon over carrier reporting retaliation
item.description: Publisher Max Lederer, editor Erik Slavin, and reporter Lara Korte are plaintiffs in a federal lawsuit alleging retaliation.

item.title: Trump signs executive order to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America'
item.description: The president signed the order at the Resolute Desk, seated before a map reading 'MAKING THE GREAT LAKES EVEN GREATER.'
